name: pastrack
description: PasTrack: controle de estoque de pastilhas industriais (backend, frontend e testes ponta a ponta)

scripts.instalar: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix backend && npm run format:check --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test:tudo: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
